passage: Last Saturday, our building cleaned the small river behind it. The water looked dirty, and plastic bags floated on the surface. At nine in the morning, about thirty neighbors gathered near the bridge. An old woman handed each of us a big bag and a pair of gloves. We walked slowly along the river and picked up every piece of trash we saw. A boy found an old shoe and laughed loudly. We collected more than ten bags of bottles, cans, and paper. At noon, we sorted the trash into different boxes. Then we washed our hands and ate noodles together. The river looked much cleaner after our work. Fish jumped in the water, and birds landed on the bridge. I felt proud of our team. A clean environment makes everyone happy, and we plan to do it again next month.
